pages.title: Retrocausal Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that formed after it was mined, its cause later than its effect. It is perfectly ordinary in appearance, which makes its history more unnerving. Holding it, I sometimes remember mining it before I have done so.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Photon Moths near white holes dropped these. I mined one before I knew what it was, and only afterward did it form, exactly where my pick had been.

Made in $(item)White Hole Emitter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Retrocausal Ore$(), in veins through the white hole interior.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Photon Moth.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Einstein-Rosen Core.
